memory_annotations.evidence_summary: The user naturally endorsed requiring both an in-room coffee maker and refrigerator or mini-fridge in this hotel comparison, while making Thursday flight margin the primary decision factor.

messages.content: The return is now the Thursday nonstop, so I only need Monday through Wednesday nights. Compare the host hotel, the nearby business hotel, and the prepaid option. Include the room cost and all local transportation we would need without a shared audit-team car.

I’ll price the three-night arrangements against the Monday preparation meeting, Tuesday and Wednesday site visits, and Thursday airport run. Before I compare them, should I include any room amenities as selection criteria, or focus only on cost, location, and cancellation terms?
I want the room to have both a coffee maker and a refrigerator or mini-fridge. Keep both in the comparison, but treat them as secondary to making the Thursday flight comfortably.

Understood. I’ll verify both room amenities where the room details are available, then calculate lodging and estimated rides for each arrangement. I’ll also check whether Wednesday night is actually bookable rather than relying on the original rate sheet.
Start with the host property. Their meeting room is where I need to be Monday afternoon.

The Meridian Conference Hotel has the audit rate Monday and Tuesday at $214 per night, plus 17% tax, but no room at that rate Wednesday. It can offer Wednesday only as part of a split stay: two nights there, then one night at Airport Link Hotel for $179 plus 17% tax. Both selected room types list a coffee maker and mini-fridge. Room total is $710.19: $500.76 at Meridian and $209.43 at Airport Link.
What does transportation add, including the hotel change?

Estimated rides total $178: $42 from IND to Meridian Monday, no ride for the on-site meeting, $54 round trip to the audit site Tuesday, $27 from Meridian to the site Wednesday, $31 from the site to Airport Link with luggage, and $24 from Airport Link to IND Thursday. The split-stay combined estimate is therefore $888.19.
Check the practical part of Wednesday. I cannot take my suitcase into the supplier site, and I do not want a room change to interfere with the audit.

Meridian will hold your suitcase after checkout, but that would require returning there after the audit before going to Airport Link. That revised routing adds about $22 and 35 to 50 minutes, making transportation approximately $200 and the split total $910.19. Airport Link confirmed Wednesday availability. Its room can be canceled without charge until 6:00 p.m. Eastern on Tuesday, July 7; Meridian’s two-night portion has the same one-day deadline, 6:00 p.m. Eastern on Sunday, July 5.
Then price the nearby business hotel as one stay. Be precise about the Monday shuttle charge.

Crossroads Business Hotel has all three nights at $189 per night plus 17% tax, for $663.39. The room description confirms a coffee maker and mini-fridge. Estimated transportation is $153: $39 from IND Monday, $36 for the hotel’s meeting-room shuttle at $18 each way, $44 for round trips to the supplier site Tuesday and Wednesday, and $34 to IND Thursday. Combined lodging and local transportation are $816.39.
Does the shuttle operate late enough after the Monday preparation meeting, and what are the cancellation terms?

Yes. Crossroads confirmed the return shuttle can be reserved for 7:15 p.m.; the $18 charge applies in each direction and is posted to the room. The three-night room is currently available and can be canceled without penalty until 4:00 p.m. Eastern on Saturday, July 4. After that, the penalty is one night including tax, or $221.13.
Now the lowest-rate property. I want to see whether it is still genuinely cheaper once rides and the airport timing are included.

Southport Suites is $159 per night plus 17% tax, prepaid, for a room total of $558.09. Estimated rides are $224: $48 from IND, $58 round trip to Meridian Monday, $72 for the two supplier-site round trips, and $46 back to IND Thursday. Its combined estimate is $782.09, which is $34.30 below Crossroads. The listed room has a coffee maker and mini-fridge, and Wednesday is available.
What is the catch beyond the distance?

The $558.09 is charged immediately and is nonrefundable, with no date changes. Southport is about 39 minutes from the supplier site in ordinary traffic and 42 to 55 minutes from IND. For the 6:40 p.m. Thursday nonstop, a 1:30 p.m. audit finish would still work, but an overrun plus afternoon traffic would narrow the margin. Crossroads is about 18 minutes from the site and 28 minutes from IND.
Put the three choices side by side, and account for retrieving luggage on Thursday. I will leave it with whichever hotel I use.

Crossroads remains $816.39: $663.39 room and $153 transportation. After a 1:30 p.m. finish, the estimate allows retrieval of luggage and arrival at IND around 2:35 p.m. The Meridian/Airport Link split is $910.19 after correcting for the Wednesday luggage retrieval route: $710.19 room and $200 transportation. Southport is $782.09: $558.09 room and $224 transportation, with likely IND arrival around 3:20 p.m. Crossroads costs $34.30 more than Southport but provides roughly 45 additional minutes of expected airport margin and remains cancellable.

The split no longer makes sense, and I do not want a nonrefundable room that far south for a $34 difference. Reserve Crossroads for the three nights. Do not add a car; the rental decision is still separate.

I’m proceeding with Crossroads Business Hotel for check-in Monday, July 6 and checkout Thursday, July 9, at $663.39 including tax. I’ll leave the shuttle uncharged for now because its two rides require times to be confirmed, and I will not add a rental car.
Give me the confirmation, cancellation deadline, full working total, and the remaining unresolved items.

Crossroads Business Hotel is reserved for July 6 through July 9 under confirmation CR7-40693. The three-night room total is $663.39 including tax; no deposit was charged. Cancel by 4:00 p.m. Eastern on Saturday, July 4 to avoid the $221.13 one-night penalty. The working local-transport estimate is $153, including the $36 Monday shuttle, so hotel plus local transportation is $816.39. With the previously purchased $548 airfare, the current trip estimate is $1,364.39. Still unresolved are the rental-car decision, final Monday shuttle pickup times, and whether ride estimates should be replaced with a car cost. Retain the hotel confirmation and cancellation terms with the flight receipt under IN7Q4L.
